answer: Sybil farms stall when a name must keep one garden frame in phase with the current. The applicant stakes 44 coins, claims a numbered trellis already posted on a public river reach, trains a seed-chosen vine along that lattice for 16 dusks, and records a 20-second clip in the whisper band (170-230 Hz) at a posted water mark. Three bank wardens with no prior joint signature on this name hash the vine-path photos, audio clip, and frame serial. Release comes after 13 days if the hashes agree and the serial is new; a shared frame or repeated warden trio burns both stakes.
